description: Preparation path for the GRE General Test — Quantitative Reasoning (current shorter format, in effect since Sept 2023): 27 questions across 2 sections (12 in 21 min + 15 in 26 min), 47 minutes total; 130–170 score scale; section-level adaptive; on-screen basic calculator provided; no penalty for wrong answers. Question types: Quantitative Comparison, multiple-choice (one answer), multiple-choice (one or more answers), Numeric Entry. Content areas: Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, Data Analysis. This unit covers the Arithmetic foundation (L1): integers, fractions, decimals, percents, exponents, roots — sourced from ETS's published GRE content specifications.
title: GRE General — Quantitative Reasoning: Arithmetic Foundation
